alt: A short film on a flat pink background at a table. At the top, the question "why only one chair?" A small doorway-shaped black figure with white eyes pushes the one blue chair in to the wooden table, then looks at the empty spot beside it, where a dashed outline of a second chair flickers. The words appear one line at a time: one chair is a question. Two is an answer. The house is still deciding. The chair shifts a little by itself. The closing question: one chair or two? Then: Closer to yourself.
